parameters.name: ChildInstanceRegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRouteTableId
parameters.description:
The routing table ID of the network instance.
If you do not specify a routing table ID when querying route entries of a VPC-connected instance, the system queries route entries in the system routing table of the VPC-connected instance by default.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

- **VPC**: virtual private cloud (VPC).

- **VBR**: virtual border router (VBR).

- **CCN**: Cloud Connect Network (CCN).

- **ECR**: Express Connect Router (ECR).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **500**.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the route entry. Valid values:

- **Active**: active.

- **Candidate**: candidate.

- **Rejected**: rejected.

- **Prohibited**: prohibited.

- **All** (default): queries route entries in all states of the network instance.
